name: Wizened Mentor
oracle_text: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a permanent that isn't a mana ability, you create a 1/1 white Zombie creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a permanent that isn't a mana ability, you create a 1/1 white Zombie creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.

needs.what: a 1/1 white Zombie creature token (no abilities)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has only black Zombies (zombie_2_2_b, zombie_2_2_b_decayed, zombie_army_0_0_b, zombie_knight_2_2_b_menace) and other 1/1 white creature types; none is a 1/1 white Zombie. The trigger itself is expressible: ability_activated with filter {controller: opponent, zone: battlefield}, mana_ability: false, max_per_turn: 1
